title: My Son Sanctuary
summary: My Son is a group of brick tower-temples in a valley in central Vietnam, built between the 4th and 13th centuries by the kings of Champa. It served as the religious and political centre of the Cham kingdom for most of its history.

uncertainty.note: The sources give only a span of centuries, from the 4th century to the 13th; 301 is the first year of the 4th century. Individual towers date to different centuries in between.

as_recorded.value: from the 4th century to the 13th century

where.modern_name: Mỹ Sơn Sanctuary, Duy Xuyên District, Quảng Nam Province, Vietnam
where.historical_name: Mỹ Sơn, religious and political capital of the Champa kingdom

importance.justification: UNESCO World Heritage property and the principal surviving ensemble of Cham temple architecture, the religious capital of Champa for most of its existence.
